digest.greeting: Good evening, Jean. The day produced a concrete Amazon Connect validation win, while the voicemail and Contact Lens fixes still need owners and end-to-end proof. Tomorrow opens with the rescheduled CLIP touchpoint and continues with launch, staffing, and Attorney Review follow-through.

items.label: Completed business validation for Core Skills Groups 1, 2, and 4
items.detail: The Amazon Connect standup update identified these three Core Skills groups as validated today.

items.label: Stop the Denver voicemail overwrite and prove the recovery path
items.detail: The investigation found that reprocessing can overwrite valid recordings with empty files, and a case-sensitive Contact Lens attribute may block analytics. Assign owners for the Lambda safeguard and configuration correction, then run an end-to-end test before setting a Denver date.

items.label: Stabilize Attorney Review and define the legal-strategy escalation
items.detail: Confirm that attorney and manager routing stays within the 15-minute response target, and define how Intake questions requiring legal strategy move to associate attorneys before tomorrow's check-in.

items.label: Close the CM CoE prioritization follow-through
items.detail: The backlog update shows progress, but the remaining work still needs a ranked plan, named owners, and clear inputs for the director briefing.

items.label: Carry the CLIP role and ownership decisions into Wednesday
items.detail: The touchpoint was rescheduled to Wednesday at 9:00 AM. Use the new slot to settle the service-line boundary, ownership, and next decisions.

items.label: Set the Salesforce banner path and repair the Grievances display issue
items.detail: Confirm the short-term Do Not Call guidance, Product ownership for the broader banner inventory, and the repair timeline for the banner that hides the Matter Plan and Documents tabs.

items.label: Confirm ownership of the Salesforce integration security review
items.detail: Name the owner checking Litify, Amazon Connect, Revenue Cloud, and other integrations for supported authentication, with a documented path for frozen or reauthentication-required accounts.

items.label: Restore or retire the disabled Power Automate flow
items.detail: Identify the affected business process, decide whether the flow is still needed, and route either the repair or retirement.

items.label: Review the Jarid coverage plan
items.detail: Confirm Stephanie Baily's advisory and review coverage, Shane's negotiation lead, the delivery timing, and any remaining gap before Jarid's vacation.

items.label: Verify the Supabase security notices through a trusted source
items.detail: One unread message reports security vulnerabilities and another grants notice was marked as spam. Check the trusted admin console or official documentation without using the email links, then route any confirmed issue.

items.label: EPMO slide focus block was cancelled
items.detail: Jean cancelled the slide-preparation block because there is no weekly meeting this week.

items.label: 9:00 AM - Rescheduled CLIP touchpoint
items.detail: The meeting moved to Wednesday because of today's scheduling conflict; use it to close role boundaries, ownership, and next steps.

items.label: 10:30 AM - Amazon Connect standup
items.detail: Bring the voicemail safeguard, Contact Lens correction, owners, and end-to-end test status into the next launch check.

items.label: 11:30 AM - Thiago 1:1; 1:00 PM - SMS Optimization staffing review
items.detail: Use the 1:1 for remaining Amazon Connect ownership questions, then confirm SMS milestones and David's weekly capacity.

items.label: 3:30 PM - Attorney Review conflicts with Laura 1:1
items.detail: Choose coverage in advance and secure a written launch-health recap from the session not attended.
